sourceMaster.description: Approved Stage 1 generated character sheet used to derive immutable comparison crops

selectedDesign.hair: refined low ponytail with long elegant waves; near-black with restrained violet sheen
selectedDesign.face: adult refined semi-realistic beauty; cool composed resting expression; soft-glam human readability
selectedDesign.silhouette: mature feminine elegant hourglass; defined waist; balanced bust and hips; long graceful legs; non-aggressive premium sensuality
selectedDesign.costume: fitted black/graphite high-fashion operator tailoring; high collar; long coat tails; smoked/sheer technical panels; fitted gloves; heeled ankle boots
selectedDesign.core: diamond signal/chest core with cyan center and restrained violet/magenta framing
selectedDesign.palette: void/graphite/matte black/deep navy with cyan, violet and selective magenta accents

authority.face: REF-FACE is authoritative for facial identity
authority.silhouette: REF-FRONT, REF-SIDE, REF-BACK and REF-3Q jointly define body and silhouette
authority.detail: REF-DETAIL is authoritative for local core, glove, boot, hair-back and material details where it does not conflict with neutral identity views
authority.presentation: REF-HERO defines presentation mood only and may not override neutral proportions

lockPolicy: Do not generatively edit or regenerate approved references during Stage 2 or later.
A material identity, hair, silhouette, costume, core or palette change reopens Stage 1 and requires explicit user approval.
Derived crops or resizes are allowed only when visual design content is unchanged and provenance remains traceable to this lock.
